notes: Canvas: 37 brushes rebuilt to behave like the real thing: pencils, charcoal, pens, markers, airbrushes, paints and washes
Paper: every canvas has one (Smooth, Drawing, Watercolour, Rough, Canvas). Pencil and charcoal catch its tooth; washes settle into it (Edit > Paper)
Pen: lean it to shade with the side of a pencil; a stroke starts from nothing instead of a blob; Looks > Pen sets how hard you press, in every mode
Paint picks up what is on the canvas and mixes like pigment (blue through yellow goes green), and leaves brush marks
They look and answer like the real thing without its chores: nothing runs out, nothing needs dipping
Airbrushes spray for as long as they are held; markers darken where strokes cross; washes dry with a darker edge
